## Why invest with DarGlobal? 
 DarGlobal is built for a new kind of global investor - one who values not just ROI, but ROE and ROL.

### Who is DarGlobal? DarGlobal develops real estate that speaks for itself, where lifestyle and value come together. We work with trusted global partners to create homes, communities, and destinations that grow in meaning and worth over time. Our approach is simple: deliver with integrity, design with care, and build with purpose. For those who see the world as their home, DarGlobal offers not just investment, but belonging — value you can measure, and pride you can feel, and a legacy you can pass forward.

### What's ROI, ROE and ROL? * **ROI (Return on Investment)**: measurable financial growth and lasting capital appreciation. * **ROE (Return on Ego)**: the pride, identity, and social value of owning something that reflects who you are and what you stand for. * **ROL (Return on Legacy)**: the confidence that what you build today will stand for something tomorrow. We see the world as one connected home — where value is something you live, not just measure. Our community of investors, partners, and visionaries builds with purpose and pride. With DarGlobal, every investment becomes a lasting mark of trust, identity, and inheritance for the future.

### What makes DarGlobal different? We work with clarity, purpose, and collaboration — turning global partnerships into lasting opportunity. Guided by over three decades of experience, every development reflects trusted execution and measurable value.

### Where does DarGlobal operate? Across 14 cities in 9 countries, including Spain, London, UAE, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Greece, the UK, and the Maldives.

Choose a project, speak with our advisors, and secure your unit digitally or through any of our international offices. Whether you live in Dubai, Riyadh, Jeddah, Muscat, Doha, London, Marbella, or New York — your investment journey begins wherever you are.

Off-plan at DarGlobal means entering early into high-growth destinations, benefiting from attractive prices, flexible payment plans, and the appreciation that comes with world-class design and brand collaborations. It’s not just smart investing — it’s securing future value today.

### Are DarGlobal projects suitable for international investors? Absolutely. DarGlobal is built for global citizens. Our destinations offer secure frameworks, full ownership rights, residency benefits, and a transparent buying process — making international investment simple, strategic, and protected.

### What kind of returns can I expect? Each development is strategically positioned for capital appreciation and strong rental yields. From premium Dubai residences to branded Marbella villas and waterfront Muscat properties, returns grow as the cities grow — delivering ROI, ROE, and ROL.

### Is my investment with DarGlobal secure and transparent? Yes. With over three decades of delivery, DarGlobal is anchored in trust, clarity, and transparent processes. Every investor is protected by local regulations, escrow systems, and our global partnerships — ensuring peace of mind at every step.

## Our Luxury Properties & Projects

### What types of properties does DarGlobal offer? From branded villas and penthouses to resort-style residences and city apartments — every DarGlobal property is crafted for lifestyle, investment, and legacy. These are homes designed to live beautifully and invest confidently.

### Where are DarGlobal properties located? Across the world’s most desirable destinations: **Dubai, Ras Al Khaimah, Muscat, Doha, Riyadh, Jeddah, Costa del Sol (Spain), the Maldives, London,** and more — each chosen for growth, desirability, and global appeal.

### What are co-branded residences? These are homes crafted in collaboration with the world’s most iconic luxury brands — from fashion to hospitality to design — offering elevated architecture, exclusive services, and long-term value driven by global brand equity.

Multiple developments across the UAE, Oman, KSA, Spain, London, and the Maldives are currently open, including high-demand branded districts and resort-led communities. Your advisor can guide you to the opportunities best aligned with your investment goals.

### Do DarGlobal properties come fully furnished or customizable? Many of our branded residences are offered fully furnished with world-class interior design. Select projects also offer customization options, allowing buyers to tailor their home to their lifestyle and aesthetic.

## Collaborations & Brand Partnerships 
 Where luxury craftsmanship meets global identity.

### Which global brands has DarGlobal collaborated with? DarGlobal partners with iconic names across fashion, hospitality, and design — delivering residences that carry global distinction and rarity.

### What makes co-branded residences unique? They offer something few can own: **ROE — Return on Ego.** Craftsmanship, scarcity, elevated lifestyle, and brand legacy come together to create homes that are not just lived in — they are admired.

Highlights  Portfolio Gross Development Value ('GDV') increased to US$19 billion (31 December 2024: GDV of US$7.5 billion)  Dar Global received approval from the UK Financial Conduct Authority (‘FCA’) for admission to the Equity Shares (Commercial Companies) category of the London Stock Exchange (‘LSE’). The Company became the first GCC-based company listed under the ESCC category.  In August 2025, Dar Global secured development rights for an integrated scheme in Riyadh valued at ~US$2.8 billion through partial land acquisitions and a joint development agreement, anchored by a US$300 million land acquisition.  In September 2025, the Company acquired a prime plot in Jeddah to launch Trump Plaza, the second collaboration in Jeddah with The Trump Organization following the success of Trump Tower.  The Company announced on 11 August 2025 a landmark joint development agreement for a mixed - use project in Jeddah, on one of th e city’s most prominent land parcels, with an estimated GDV of approximately ~US$1.95 billion. These are significant parcels of land with the opportunity to develop luxury villas, a world-class golf course and a luxury hotel.  The Company has awarded the m ain construction contracts for Trump Tower Jeddah; The Astera, Interiors by Aston Martin; Marea by Missoni (Blocks C and D); Great Escape Apartments; and Phase 1 of the Aida development in Oman, comprising 91 villas and 60 townhouses.  Dar Global extended its Litmus Facility by an additional US$165 million, bringing the total limit under the Litmus Facility to US$440 million further enhancing liquidity and supporting acquisition / expansion across key international markets.  As announced on 11 August 2025, Dar Global intends to enter the financial services sector in the Dubai International Finance Centre (‘DIFC’), enabling it to offer asset management, investment banking, and advisory services through an independently governed subsidiary. This strategic move will open new revenue streams, attract capital from the GCC and beyond, support larger -scale, capital -efficient projects, and enable entry into new geographies.  On 18 November 2025, Dar Global and The Trump Organization announced Trump International Hotel Maldives, a tokenised hotel development project. With strong sales 2 momentum, accelerating project execution, and a strate gic foothold in Saudi Arabia ahead of its landmark opening to foreign investors, we remain resilient.
